title: 第25章 明镜晕倒
novel_title: 我在星际召唤古人，带飞华夏文明
content_zh:
赤日炎炎，一群衣衫褴褛的人走在干裂的地面上。

    一对骑马的官差分别将一行人前后包围，催促大家走快点，时不时还扬起马鞭打在某些人身上。

    “走快点，别耽搁时辰。”

    “你听不懂本大人说话吗？让你走快点。”

    啪啪的鞭子声持续响起，大家走得全无精气神。

    在鞭子落下的那一刻，他们只是身体抖了两下，勉强加快了一点速度。

    “阿娘，我走不动了。”

    明镜气喘吁吁地跟在荣华身后，扯着衣袖擦了下鬓角的汗水，望着始终看不见终点的官道，眼前一阵阵发黑。

    荣华回头瞥了下闺女的脸色，返回去把人牵着，使劲拖着人往前走。

    “忍一忍，应该很快会到了，只要再走过一座城池我们就能到地方了。”

    “不行，我真的走不动了。”

    明镜大喘着粗气，脸色都涨红了两分，她看着面前的两个重影，脚下虚浮地往荣华靠近。

    “阿娘，我好像有点不对劲，脑袋有点晕...”

    她话还没说完，眼皮一翻，人竟直直地往后仰去。

    “我的儿！”

    荣华瞬间被吓得花容失色，连忙上前将人抱住。

    可走了这么久，她的体力严重不足，加上明镜又太重，她反而还被力道拖着往下坠。

    “阿娘！”

    “夫人！”

    “嫂嫂！”

    走在前方的明家人听到动静回头，一见荣华和明镜两人朝地上倒去，一群人齐齐被吓得心惊肉跳。

    明阳和明远征迅速往两人的方向跑去，在千钧一发之际，及时接住了倒地的两人。

    前方骑马的一位官差被身后的动静惊到，勒住马调转马头往几人面前走来。

    “怎么回事？不许停下。”

    接住明镜的明阳，拍了拍妹妹苍白的脸颊，见她没有动静，回头对着官差哀求道：

    “大人，能否让我们休息片刻，我妹妹晕了过去，求求您。”
content_en:
In the scorching red sun, a group of people in ragged clothes walked on the cracked ground.

    A pair of horse-riding officers surrounded the group from front to back, urging everyone to move faster, and from time to time they would raise their whips to hit some people.

    "Go faster, don't waste time."

    "Don't you understand what I'm saying? I want you to walk faster."

    The sound of cracking whips continued, and everyone walked away without energy.

    The moment the whip fell, they just shook their bodies twice and barely sped up a little.

    "Auntie, I can't walk anymore."

    Ming Jing followed Rong Hua panting, pulling his sleeves to wipe the sweat from his temples, looking at the official road where the end could not be seen, his eyes darkened for a while.

    Ronghua turned around and glanced at his daughter's face, then returned to hold her hand and drag her forward with all her strength.

    "Just be patient, we should be there soon. We only need to walk through one more city to get there."

    "No, I really can't walk."

    Ming Jing gasped for breath, her face turned red. She looked at the two double figures in front of her and walked towards Ronghua in vain.

    "Mommy, something seems wrong with me, my head is a little dizzy..."

    Before she could finish her words, her eyelids rolled up and she leaned straight back.

    "My son!"

    Rong Hua was instantly frightened to death and quickly stepped forward to hug him.

    But after walking for so long, her physical strength was severely lacking, and the mirror was too heavy, so she was dragged down by the force.

    "Aniang!"

    "Madam!"

    "Sister-in-law!"

    The Ming family members who were walking in front turned around when they heard the noise. When they saw Rong Hua and Ming Jing falling to the ground, a group of people were frightened.

    Mingyang and Ming Yuanzheng quickly ran in the direction of the two people, and at the critical moment, they caught the two people who fell to the ground in time.

    An officer riding a horse in front was startled by the movement behind him. He reined in his horse and turned around and walked towards the people.

    "What's going on? Don't stop."

    Mingyang caught the mirror and patted his sister's pale cheek. Seeing that she didn't move, he turned back to the official and begged:

    "Sir, can you let us rest for a while? My sister fainted. Please."
